high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of a social media post by Karuna G, who is passionate about weather. The post includes a photograph of a thunderstorm with multiple lightning strikes visible against a dark sky. The cityscape in the background shows buildings silhouetted against the stormy sky. The text in the post provides safety tips for dealing with unexpected thunderstorms: If there is an unexpected thunderstorm in the open field, you should always crouch and then wait for the thunderstorm with your legs tightly closed.
